description.value:
For some, chems and stims aren't a vice — they're a way of life. Berserkers of the Addicted Approach have learned to fold that hunger into their fury, letting the burn of a substance fan the flames of rage rather than dull them.

Where discipline fails these warriors, dependency succeeds: the deeper they lean into their cravings, the more ferocious and unshakeable they become in a fight, even as that same dependency threatens to consume them.
